contentValues.8c9bc31b-36d3-4776-92ef-d6e0a00c4044:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Kumori BDI Monitor listener
  version: "1.0"
  description: Boomi Integration Web Services Server listener that lists Boomi Data Integration flows (read-only).
servers:
  - url: https://boomi.kumori.ai
security:
  - listenerAuth: []
paths:
  /ws/simple/getListFlows:
    get:
      operationId: listFlows
      security:
        - listenerAuth: []
      summary: List BDI flows
      responses:
        "200":
          description: BDI Rivers API list, passed through by the Integration process
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/FlowList"
components:
  securitySchemes:
    listenerAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: Authorization
      description: "Basic <base64 user:token> for the runtime's shared web server user"
  schemas:
    FlowList:
      type: object
      properties:
        total_items:
          type: integer
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Flow"
    Flow:
      type: object
      properties:
        river_cross_id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        river_type:
          type: string
        river_status:
          type: string
        last_updated_at:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
